anchorBatch(bytes32,uint256).notice: Anchor a SHA-256 Merkle root committing to a batch of QRNG payment nonces.

pay(address,bytes32).notice: Direct payment from caller to `to`. `memoHash` ties the payment to an off-chain record (e.g. hash of the x402 payment payload or quantum nonce).

refundEscrow(uint256).notice: Refund escrowed funds to the payer. Callable by the payer after timeout, or the admin (arbiter) at any time.

releaseEscrow(uint256).notice: Release escrowed funds to the payee. Callable by the payer (early release) or the admin (arbiter). Bumps payee reputation if a registry is set.

splitPay(address[],uint256[],bytes32).notice: Multi-hop / multi-recipient split payment. Sum of amounts must equal msg.value.
